# GST status fixtures

Answers Tally gave on 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-12 on the synthetic company `BRIDGE PILOT LAB`
(TallyPrime 7.1 Silver, licensed mode). The 12 Oct answer is to the request the tool sends; the
10 Oct answers are to earlier requests, which did not fetch `ISPOSTDATED` (the two narrow ones
did not fetch `ISCANCELLED` and `ISOPTIONAL` either), and the tool reads every voucher in them as
unread.

The 12 Oct answer and its request are published on `lab/1342-w21b-answers` (commit `c5763eafb`)
and `lab/1342-capture-requests` (commit `41c655940`); each file here is byte-equal to the file there,
whose SHA-256 is recorded in that branch's `SHA256.txt` (no GSTIN was masked in it). The answer was
read with one invoice keyed for it and marked post-dated by hand (Ctrl+T), dated 2026-08-25, the day
Tally's current date (the date set with F2) had been set to during the read; the voucher was deleted
and the book restored afterwards. The 10 Oct
answers are described below. The answers are published on the branch `lab/1342-capture-answers` (the two
reads of the narrow window at commit `e67df2c72`, the wider read at commit `4b5ad93cf`); each answer
here is byte-equal to the file there (its SHA-256 is the one recorded for that file when it was published).
The request is on `lab/1342-capture-requests` (commit `1e7317c5`).

The data is synthetic: the company, its GSTIN (of the synthetic family the fixtures may carry) and
its vouchers were made for this measurement. One book, one release. The answers are UTF-16LE with
no byte order mark, as received; the request file begins with a byte order mark.

The same request with the voucher type selected by its GUID instead of its name was answered as `aw8-status-narrow-window-sales.xml` (commit `313f5439b` of `lab/1342-capture-answers`). Its SHA-256 is `504d9b06911e222b31d585a092e0192a0a263ede91b9fdc5173040438a1e1672`, equal to the by-name answer above, so it is not committed a second time; the protocol reference (section 9.20) cites it. The one uncertain voucher (`BP/26-27/0002`, dated 2026-08-01) lies outside the two-day window of the narrow answers and is shown only by the `three-vouchers` answer.

The six `pilot-lab-gst-uncertain-` files are from the lab's run of 13 Oct 2026 on the same synthetic company (TallyPrime 7.1 Silver, one run, one book), published on `lab/1342-w21d-answers` (commit `d1070dead`); each file here is byte-equal to the file there, whose SHA-256 is recorded in that branch's `SHA256.txt`. The answers carry no byte order mark and the request does, as above. The one Accept As Is was made on Tally's own screen, and the book was restored afterwards. What the run did not cover: an item invoice, a registered buyer, a credit note or another Sales-class type, a foreign-currency voucher, the amount of a post-dated voucher, an Accept As Is of several vouchers at once, Gold and other releases.

**The order of the lab's run** (`send-log.txt`, UTC, 13 Oct 2026): marks (`aw21d-marks-0`, voucher mark 68), the count read (`-a`), the wide read before (`-b`), three invoices looked at, a backup, the Accept As Is, the wide read after (`-c`), marks (`-marks-1`, voucher mark 69), the restore, marks (`-marks-2`, equal to the first). The count read was not made again after the accept. The tests of `gst_uncertain_vouchers` serve a call on the before answer the first marks and the count read, and a call on the after answer the second marks and, for lack of a count read after the accept, the same count read as before (the tool does not compare a mark with a voucher's `ALTERID`, and takes no status from the count).

The company-list read that opens every call of `gst_uncertain_vouchers` is served from `agent/pilot-lab/pilot-lab-company-extent.utf16le.xml`, the lab's answer of 9 Oct 2026 (four days before the run above; the lab did not read the list again in it) to the request `r01-company-extent.xml` (`9df2a53f085dac2636e9435462b612c1487ec6f903677815036c9f39163f7dd8`); a test compares the hash of the request the code sends. The health checks that follow each read are the simulator's own status page, **not a capture of Tally**: the run did not record `GET /status`.
